summary: Independent Playwright probe against the frozen actual Go/WASM demo supports disabled native suppression and physical focus preservation. Across DOM, React, and GoDOM, the disabled .click calls, later mouse click, and keyboard typing produced zero instrumented Go runtime dispatches; post-attempt physical input, Go state/messages, and dirty IDs remained unchanged. The recorded DOM event log proves zero events for the disabled .click calls only; it was sampled before mouse/keyboard input and provides no DOM-event result for those actions. A separately counted direct Go read-only input dispatch returned an unchanged snapshot with no dirty IDs. Direct host replacement preserved physical focus and the noncollapsed backward selection [8,17] immediately and after settling on all three renderers. Exact hashes, results, initial probe-only harness correction, and scope limits are in reports/O-BROWSER.md; no assets were rebuilt and no production source was changed.
